title: Crestline Credit Card Billing Cycle, Due Date and Payment Channels
content:
A Crestline Credit Card billing cycle closes on the statement closing day the cardholder chose, and the payment due date falls a fixed number of days after the statement closing date. A payment is on time when it is received by 17:00 ET on the due date.

## Billing and payment terms

| Product | Days from closing to due date | Payment cutoff on the due date | Closing days offered | Payment channels | Fee for a payment through a live phone representative |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | 23 | 17:00 ET | 3, 10, 17 or 24 | online, phone, mail, in store, autopay | 0 USD |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | 23 | 17:00 ET | 3, 10, 17 or 24 | online, phone, mail, in store, autopay | 0 USD |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | 23 | 17:00 ET | 3, 10, 17 or 24 | online, phone, mail, in store, autopay | 0 USD |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 25 | 17:00 ET | 3, 10, 17 or 24 | online, phone, mail, autopay | 0 USD |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 25 | 17:00 ET | 3, 10, 17 or 24 | online, phone, mail, autopay | 0 USD |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 25 | 17:00 ET | 3, 10, 17 or 24 | online, phone, mail, autopay | 0 USD |

## Points of reference

- **Grace period.** The days from closing to due date are also the grace period: standard purchases paid in full by the due date incur no interest.
- **Automated phone payments** are free on every product, and the live-representative phone fee is 0 USD as well.
- **In-store payments** are accepted on the three private-label products only.

Hypothetical illustration: on a Crestline Auto Care Mastercard statement closing on the 10th of a month, the due date is the date 25 days later; on a Crestline Auto Care Card statement closing the same day it is the date 23 days later.
